stem: Heavy supplies are stored on the floor behind other containers, requiring deep reach and low lifts. Which redesign best addresses the exposure at its source?
choices: Tell workers to stretch before every lift
Require workers to lift more slowly
Move the heavy supplies to an accessible working height and reduce reach distance
Rotate the same floor-lifting task among more workers without changing storage
rationale: Changing storage height and reach geometry reduces the task exposure for every repetition rather than relying only on worker behavior.
